## Verification

- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make validate`
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Public docs/examples and `[Unreleased]` changelog updated when applicable
- [ ] Frontend lint/test/build and embedded bundle refreshed when applicable

Do not include tokens, provider keys, real stores/backups, or private payloads.
